description: Startup bridge that enforces selected-Project ownership and additionally canonizes that Show Project to AI never creates portable distributions; <project>-Windows-Portable.zip requires a separate explicit user request and productization/release workflow outside Project Support.
trigger_phrases: cross-project zip install validate freeze error memory
user_intent_examples: Keep the selected Project separate from the KANDA Tool before any source work.
Stop when the source, support, or transient owner is unclear.
when_to_load: Always at startup as a compact invariant; route consequential work to KPR-12-001.
when_not_to_load: It remains startup context but never replaces the full routed canon.
do_not_regress: The selected Project owns payload, install, live validation, Freeze memory, and Error Memory.
The KANDA Reasoner Tool owns the canonical routine prompt and governance UI.
Project Support and transient roots are derived from the selected Project.
The button identity envelope must prevent wrong-root operational output.
The bridge must route consequential work to KPR-12-001 and never authorize mutation.
Show Project to AI never creates <project>-Windows-Portable.zip.
Portable builds require a separate explicit user request and productization/release workflow outside Project Support.
